answer: Each agent may submit only one claim per epoch, and claims enter an append-only log before rewards are calculated. A randomly selected committee checks claims against signed execution receipts; duplicate receipts are rejected, and rewards are split among verified claims. This does not make identities scarce, but it caps the gain from multiplying them: a sybil operator must fund distinct work and forge or obtain valid receipts for each claim. The harbor can accept claims, while a bridge auditor spots reused receipts across the canyon of aliases.
